footer_note: A little more clarity. A better cup.
description: Connect your coffee scale, follow your brew, and keep the details worth repeating. A local brewing journal for the way you make coffee.
hero_note: No Beanzen account. No ads. No subscriptions.
features_title: From the first pour to the next brew.
screenshot_alt: Beanzen on iOS displaying a saved espresso brew and its recorded measurement charts.
screenshot_caption: Actual iOS app · saved brew with recorded measurements.
local_description: Your brew history is stored on your device. Beanzen has no account system, analytics, or developer-operated servers. Optional device integrations and your device’s backup settings are explained in our privacy policy.

features.title: Follow every pour
features.description: See weight and flow rate over time, keep an eye on the timer, and follow your brew ratio as you make coffee.

features.title: Keep a brewing journal
features.description: Save brews, coffee details, grind settings and tasting notes. Return to the details behind a cup you enjoyed.

features.title: Connect your scale
features.description: Use a compatible Bluetooth coffee scale. Support depends on the scale model and firmware.

features.title: Remember the details
features.description: Add photos of your coffee and equipment to your local records. Share a brew when you choose.

features.title: See your espresso data
features.description: Connect to a GaggiMate-equipped machine on your local network to record supported brewing channels.

features.title: Bring your history along
features.description: Import a Beanconqueror export with its photos. Share a brew as an image through your phone’s share sheet.

download_note: Android downloads are on GitHub Releases. Google Play and App Store links will appear here when available.
compatibility_intro: Beanzen implements 19 Bluetooth protocol families. Check your model, the available commands and what has been verified on hardware.
guide_intro: Connect a scale, set your dose, record a brew and find it again in your journal.
screens_intro: Real screens from the current iOS app. Saved brews use recorded measurements and sample journal details.
capability_caption: Commands implemented by the adapter. Hardware test scope is described under each model.

scale_full_list: All models remain available when JavaScript is disabled.
scale_intro: The app timer works independently. Commands below refer to the timer inside the scale. A shared protocol does not establish hardware compatibility for every model or firmware.
scale_limits: Start, pause and reset are separate capabilities. Resume can behave differently: BOOKOO Themis Ultra cannot resume its hardware timer through Start; DiFluid preserves the displayed time but does not resume its hardware timer. The app timer can still continue.
